name: Emergency (police, fire, ambulance)
purpose: Single emergency number for police, fire and ambulance anywhere in India.

name: Ambulance
purpose: Free emergency ambulance in most states.

name: Police
purpose: Police control room. 112 also reaches the police.

name: Women helpline
purpose: Support for women facing harassment, violence or feeling unsafe.

name: Cyber fraud helpline
purpose: Report online or UPI fraud quickly. Early reporting helps freeze the money.

name: e-Shram helpline
purpose: Help with e-Shram registration, UAN card and linked benefits for unorganised and gig workers.
available: Check current hours on the e-Shram portal

name: Free legal aid (NALSA)
purpose: Information on free legal services for people who qualify.

name: National Consumer Helpline
purpose: Complaints about refunds, overcharging and services bought as a consumer.
available: Check current hours on the consumer helpline portal

name: National Highways helpline
purpose: Accidents, breakdowns and help on national highways.
